name: Redemption
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [curse, language-dependent, mind-affecting]; Level cleric/oracle 8, legendary inquisitor 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Target one living creature
Duration until discharged (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as geas/quest, except that there’s no time limit to the task imposed on the target. When the task is complete, or the caster declares herself satisfied, the target can automatically receive the effects of atonement if it’s willing to.
